target.title: fix(codex): cap compaction override warning cache via createDedupeCache
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes unbounded memory growth in the Codex app-server compaction override warning deduplication. The `warnedIgnoredCompactionOverrides` Set accumulated every warned override key forever with no eviction, TTL, or size cap.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replaced the unbounded `Set<string>` with `createDedupeCache({ ttlMs: 0, maxSize: 4096 })`, imported from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/dedupe-runtime` per extension boundary policy. The `check()` method provides touch-on-read LRU semantics.

## User Impact

No change for gateways handling fewer than 4 096 distinct ignored compaction-override keys. Gateways exceeding the cap may see one extra warning per evicted entry, a bounded trade-off versus the prior unbounded growth.

## Evidence

### Real-path proof — `maybeCompactCodexAppServerSession` exercised with the actual module

The proof imports the real `compact.js` module, calls `maybeCompactCodexAppServerSession` twice with identical compaction-override config, and captures the warning output. The module-level `createDedupeCache.check()` deduplicates correctly:

```text
$ pnpm vitest run --project extension-codex extensions/codex/src/app-server/compact.proof.test.ts

[warn] ignoring OpenClaw compaction overrides for Codex app-server compaction; Codex uses native server-side compaction
 ✓ real module deduplication proof > deduplicates identical configs (warning fires once, then suppressed)

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  1 passed (1)
```

- First call: `warnIfIgnoringOpenClawCompactionOverrides` → `createDedupeCache.check()` returns false (new key) → warning emitted
- Second call (same config): `createDedupeCache.check()` returns true (cached) → warning suppressed

### Cache cap and LRU eviction

`createDedupeCache({ ttlMs: 0, maxSize: 4096 })` is the same shared helper used by Telegram and Slack. The cache cap and LRU touch-on-read behavior are verified by the existing unit tests:

```text
$ pnpm vitest run src/infra/dedupe.test.ts --reporter=verbose

 ✓ createDedupeCache > keeps entries indefinitely when ttlMs is zero or negative
 ✓ createDedupeCache > touches duplicate reads so the newest key survives max-size pruning
 ... 5 passed (5)
```
